verdict.rationale: monday.com's docs say each agent gets its own identity and that admins can scope each agent's board access and audit its actions. Separately, the docs note that apps can request granular scopes like `boards:read` with keys held in managed secret storage, which together approximate least-privilege agent access. However, the evidence never explicitly describes issuing per-agent API tokens or credentials. missing for 10: explicit per-agent API credential/token issuance flow, documentation of scope granularity beyond board access, token rotation/expiry, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
